chunks: As for whatever is in it from Zakariyya ibn Adam, I have narrated it from Ahmad ibn Ziyad ibn Ja'far al-Hamdani — may Allah be pleased with him — from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Ahmad ibn Ishaq ibn Sa'd, from Zakariyya ibn Adam al-Qummi, the companion of al-Rida عليه السلام.

key_terms.الْقُمِّيِّ: A nisbah indicating affiliation with Qum
key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: A supplication meaning: may Allah be pleased with him
key_terms.صَاحِبِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: A companion of Imam al-Rida عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain for narrations from Zakariyya ibn Adam in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Zakariyya ibn Adam. It serves as a transmission-chain notice in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih, identifying Zakariyya ibn Adam al-Qummi as a companion of Imam al-Rida عليه السلام.
